quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Fixating on a small, controllable detail before a much bigger, uncontrollable reunion points to a specific unease about what's coming.
quests.explanation: Focusing on a small, manageable detail before a much larger, uncertain reunion is a classic sign of apprehension.
quests.textToSpeak: I've agreed to meet him for coffee after fifteen years of not speaking. I keep changing my mind about which chair to sit in, as if that's the part that matters.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A group honoring a milestone that no longer has a person to celebrate it, purely for someone else's comfort, points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: A group honoring a lost milestone purely for someone else's comfort is the kind of gesture that leaves you deeply touched.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole crew he worked with for thirty years came to the house, unannounced, on what would have been his last day before retirement, just to sit with my mother for the afternoon.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone at the very start of their career redirecting a room full of senior opinion, with a single question, points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone new redirecting an entire room of senior opinion with one well-placed question is a genuine cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: The first-year resident asked one quiet question in the meeting that reframed a diagnosis six of us, including me, had already agreed on.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A professional obligation that directly threatens the relationship that built your career points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: A professional duty that threatens the very relationship that built your career is a genuine, difficult conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Publishing the findings ends a research partnership that gave me my career. Not publishing them means staying quiet about something the funding body has a right to know.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Help arriving from someone you had every reason not to expect it from points to a warm, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Real, sustained help from someone you had every reason not to expect it from is a striking cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter's ex-husband, of all people, is the one who drove four hours each way, twice a month, so she wouldn't have to make that drive alone after the surgery.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Finally clearing away preparations for a conversation you've fully accepted will never happen points to a settled feeling.
quests.explanation: Finally clearing away long-held preparations for a conversation you've accepted will never happen is a quiet resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: I used to keep a folder of things I wanted to say to her someday. I cleared it out last year. There wasn't going to be a someday, and I'd known that for a while.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone who spent a lifetime serving others finally advocate fully for themselves brings a specific, deep feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching someone who spent a lifetime helping others finally advocate fully for themselves is a profound, specific pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My mother, who spent forty years translating for other people's doctors' appointments so they wouldn't have to, sat in her own appointment last week and asked every question herself, in her own words, needing no one.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Facing a familiar, high-stakes situation where, for the first time, the usual outcome feels genuinely uncertain points to unease about what's ahead.
quests.explanation: Facing a familiar high-stakes moment where the outcome feels newly uncertain is a clear apprehension.
quests.textToSpeak: The board meeting where they decide whether to keep funding the clinic is in an hour. I've given this same funding pitch for six years running. This year I actually don't know which way it goes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A question about a bigger, unchosen path failing to register at all, in a genuinely good moment, points to a calm feeling.
quests.explanation: A question about the road not taken failing to land, in a moment that already feels complete, reflects genuine contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: Someone asked today if I regret never opening a second location like I used to talk about. Watching the same regulars walk in and call the barista by name, the question just didn't land.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A pattern nobody in a family has broken before showing its first real sign of breaking points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: A first real sign of breaking an old, unspoken family pattern is a grounded and meaningful hope.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody in this family has finished a full year of the program before. My nephew just finished his first. He starts year two on Monday, like it's nothing. Maybe for him, by now, it actually is.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A supposedly neutral recommendation that happens to benefit the recommender directly tends to raise doubt.
quests.explanation: A neutral-sounding recommendation that conveniently benefits the person making it is a fair basis for skepticism.
quests.textToSpeak: The consultant's report recommends the exact restructuring package his own firm happens to specialize in implementing, out of every option he says he considered.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being the last person who remembers a version of yourself that no one else can confirm points to a profound, quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: Being the last person who remembers a true version of your own past is a deep, particular loneliness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've outlived every person who remembers me as a young man. There's no one left to correct the stories, so eventually, I suppose, the stories just become what happened.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Facing so many urgent, unrelated demands that you freeze rather than choose one points to a flooded state.
quests.explanation: Facing so many urgent demands at once that you freeze entirely is a vivid picture of being overwhelmed.
quests.textToSpeak: Between the funeral arrangements, the will neither of us can find, and my own children needing me three states away, I stood at the kitchen counter this morning holding two different phones and answering neither.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Knowing precisely what you intend to do while doubting your own composure to carry it out points to unease about the moment ahead.
quests.explanation: Knowing exactly what to say while doubting your own composure to deliver it is a specific, grounded apprehension.
quests.textToSpeak: I've written and deleted the opening line of this eulogy four times. I know exactly what I want to say. I don't know yet if I'll get through saying it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, physical detail of a table worn down by generations of the same joy points to a warm, full feeling.
quests.explanation: A small physical trace of generations sharing the same joy, still happening, is a full and simple happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: Four generations sat around that same scratched table tonight, the youngest one banging a spoon in roughly the same spot the wood's already worn thin from decades of the same thing.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A stranger maintaining a private, unclaimed act of remembrance for years, entirely on their own, points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: A stranger maintaining an unclaimed act of remembrance for years, entirely unasked, is a profound feeling of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: On the anniversary, a stranger who'd read about it years ago in an old newspaper article left flowers at the gate, with no name, the same week every year, for longer than I even knew to look for them.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A long-term plan resting on one specific assumption that has just publicly failed points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: A long-term plan collapsing over one specific assumption failing is a real, significant disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I built the whole retirement plan around this pension surviving the buyout. The new owners announced this morning that it doesn't.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Checking daily for news that has a known, distant date attached points to a restless, ongoing feeling.
quests.explanation: Checking daily for news that isn't due for weeks is a familiar, everyday form of anxiety.
quests.textToSpeak: The appeal decision isn't due for another six weeks. I've caught myself checking the court's website every morning before coffee anyway, like the date might have quietly moved up.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A decision that clearly helps the people you're responsible for while ending something you built and value points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: A decision that helps the people you're responsible for while ending something you personally built is a genuine conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Selling the practice to the larger group means my staff finally get real benefits for the first time in twenty years. It also means the small, walk-in, pay-what-you-can model that built this place ends the day the papers are signed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone new to a role asking the single question that experienced people had missed for years points to admiration.
quests.explanation: Someone new asking the one crucial question that experienced people missed for years is a genuine cause of being impressed.
quests.textToSpeak: The youngest board member, barely a year into the role, asked the one question in the entire three-hour meeting that the auditors later said should have been asked years ago.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone extending real, unpaid time purely so you're not left alone with hard news points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone extending unpaid time purely so you're not alone with hard news is a deep, direct gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My interpreter for the hearing stayed an extra unpaid hour afterward, just sitting with me in the hallway, so I wouldn't have to process what was decided alone before the drive home.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Deliberately abandoning a way of measuring something painful, choosing ordinary time instead, points to a settled feeling.
quests.explanation: Deliberately abandoning a painful way of measuring time, in favor of ordinary days, is a quiet resignation.
quests.textToSpeak: I stopped keeping track of the years since the diagnosis a while back. Counting them made it feel like a countdown. Not counting them, it's just Tuesday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching a family's history with an institution turn, across generations, from rejection to recognition brings a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching a family's history with an institution shift across generations, from rejection to recognition, is a profound pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My son, who spent his twenties telling us this field would never work out, just gave the keynote at the same conference his father once got turned away from as a young man with no connections.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being prepared for your own part in something while genuinely unsure of someone else's reliability points to unease about what's ahead.
quests.explanation: Being ready for your own role while genuinely unsure of someone else's follow-through is a grounded apprehension.
quests.textToSpeak: The custody mediation resumes in twenty minutes. I know my part of the agreement. I don't yet know if he'll actually stick to his.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being fully present in a smaller, real version of an old ambition, without measuring the gap, points to a calm feeling.
quests.explanation: Being fully present in a smaller, real version of an old ambition, without measuring the gap, reflects genuine contentment.
quests.textToSpeak: The clinic never expanded the way I once mapped out on a napkin in my twenties. Watching the same three nurses who started with me still greet patients by name this morning, I didn't think about the napkin at all.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A repeated question, each time believed to be new, points to a specific, uneasy feeling about someone you love.
quests.explanation: A loved one repeating the same question, each time believing it's new, is a natural and reasonable cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: My father's called the bank three times this week to ask the same balance question, each time convinced it was the first time he'd asked.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: People you shaped, now scattered and independent, still choosing the same gesture without coordinating it, points to a deep feeling.
quests.explanation: People you shaped, now independent, all choosing the same gesture without coordinating it, is a profound feeling of being touched.
quests.textToSpeak: Every single former apprentice I ever trained, some of them now running their own shops across three counties, closed up early on the same afternoon, without discussing it with each other, to come to my last day.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being permitted, by the evidence itself, to sound more optimistic for the first time points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: Being permitted by real evidence, for the first time, to use a hopeful word is a grounded and earned hope.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody's calling it a recovery yet, and the specialist is careful never to promise more than the data shows. But for the first time since this began, the data is the reason we're allowed to say that at all.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A community formally honoring, after the fact, someone whose work went uncredited while they were alive points to a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: A community formally honoring someone's uncredited work, after the fact, is a deep and moving gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: The whole town council, unprompted, renamed the community garden after my late wife, the one she'd fought three separate committees for over a decade to get approved while she was alive to see none of the credit.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A personally right decision that still leaves behind something others have depended on for a long time points to a torn feeling.
quests.explanation: A decision that's right for you but still leaves behind something others depended on for decades is a genuine conflict.
quests.textToSpeak: Retiring now means finally having time for my own grandchildren the way I never had time for my own children. It also means handing this clinic to someone who, however capable, isn't going to run it the way the people here have relied on for thirty years.
